Task1 · Actual mid-high-carrier comparison

NEW actual5000/5030Hz and9000/9030Hz analyses versus CACHED actual3000/3030Hz sine reference; all three beat frequencies are30Hz. The9000Hz basis is reused;5030/9030Hz are distinct actual frequencies. Earlier9000/9090Hz (90Hz beat) is separate. Initial bare2000/2010Hz is a separate historical condition. No physiological equivalence is claimed. Same original4-square-pad geometry,2 independent outputs/common GND/50Ω; fixed D50mm and0.1/5/5/15mm layers. Values are precomputed, not recomputed by this page.

Primary ROI:r≤5mm,depth15–20mm. WholeXY at that depth is supplemental. All field tables/bars use V/m; burdens use A/m²,V RMS,W,mA. maxTIS is a2074-direction sampled maximum; fixedTIS uses(X+Y)/√2; RMS is not TIS modulation. Here both active sine carriers are included in RMS.

Calculated and unadopted. Existing SC/XY/bulk/contact convergence holds remain; no new C1 control, instrument-loaded prediction, experimental validation or safety certification. Skin/contact-only can exceed1Vpp numerically; legacy composite additionally caps source power and1Vpp. Current sum is output-RMS bookkeeping, not common-return current.

Previous overall4–8–12–16-pad GUI (unchanged). This new screen contains shared-axis scalar bars, not new-frequency spatial maps. Old maps must not be relabeled as these sine results.

Actual mid/high frequency provenance: producer regression must pass before the mid/high-frequency bundle. Regression is a same-operator/code-path check, not independent-solver or mesh validation. This run records6 new RHS at5000/5030/9030Hz,2 reused cached9000Hz RHS and4 reused3k regression RHS; the original failed-stage cost is preserved. Donor provenance was checked by the producer; this viewer reads only the new regression proof JSON, not old failed-run JSON or native files. Square3k and sine3k are separately named cap/current/power references; fixed high-volume cutoffs always remain the original square3k values.
